title: Treasury Offset Program Referral and State Refund Intercept for Benefit Overpayment Accounts
content:
**(a) Eligible debts.** A debt on a Benefit Overpayment Accounts record whose classification allows it may be recovered from federal tax refunds through the Treasury Offset Program and from state tax refunds by intercept; agency-error, employer-reporting-error and appeal-reversal debts are never referred.

**(b) Notice of intent.** A notice of intent is mailed only when all three of the following hold: the balance is at least the minimum referral debt; the debt is delinquent because the days since the last recovery have reached the delinquency days; and no repayment plan is current. The days since the last recovery are the calendar days since the latest repayment, offset or intercept on the overpayment, or since its determination date when there has been none.

**(c) Referral after the notice period.** A debt is referred to the Treasury Offset Program only on or after the notice period after the date the notice of intent was sent. The notice period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the notice of intent was sent, and referral on the last day of the period is not yet allowed; state refund intercept may begin after its own shorter notice period counted the same way. The date the notice was sent is the notice date on the Department's overpayment record.

**(d) Referral not made, and withdrawal.** If, before referral, the claimant pays in full, sets up a plan or files a timely request for review, the referral is not made; a referred debt that becomes current under a plan or reaches zero is withdrawn from referral.

**(e) Intercepted amounts.** Intercepted amounts are applied under the Department's recovery order for open overpayments, and an intercept larger than the balance is refunded.

## Counting the notice periods

The Treasury Offset Program notice period is 60 days and the state refund intercept notice period is 30 days.

| Notice of intent sent (hypothetical) | Period | Day 1 | Last day of the period | Not yet allowed on | First day allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 January 2026 | Treasury Offset Program, 60 days | 11 January | 11 March | 11 March | 12 March |
| 10 January 2026 | State refund intercept, 30 days | 11 January | 9 February | 9 February | 10 February |

## Conditions for the notice of intent

| Balance at least the minimum referral debt | Days since last recovery reached the delinquency days | A plan is current | Notice of intent mailed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| No | Yes | No | No |
| Yes | No | No | No |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
